Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Fixed the core buying workflow. AutoBuy now requests Market Board listing data for each matching item, reviews returned listings against the configured price cap and HQ setting, and sends purchase requests for eligible listings instead of only inspecting already-visible UI rows.
